items.title: Famous Chollima Hackers Target PHP Developers Using Compromised Packagist Package
items.description: A well-known North Korean threat actor has been caught hiding malware inside a legitimate PHP package available through Packagist, the main package repository for PHP projects. items.title: Hackers Attacking Signal Users to Steal Backups in New Wave of Attacks
items.description: A new wave of phishing attacks is targeting users of Signal, the encrypted messaging app trusted by journalists, activists, and privacy-conscious individuals worldwide. Hackers are impersonating Signal’s support team and tricking users into handing over their backup recovery keys, which can unlock entire archives of private chat history.
